subtopics.name: Bookkeeping, Accounting and Its Branches
objectives: Differentiate between bookkeeping and accounting
Trace the historical background of bookkeeping and accounting
List the branches of accounting: cost accounting, management accounting, auditing, financial accounting and taxation
Examine the role of accounting records and information in decision making and identify users of accounting information

subtopics.name: Accounting Concepts and Conventions
objectives: Identify accounting concepts: business entity, going concern, accrual, consistency, prudence, materiality, historical cost, money measurement, dual aspect
Apply the right principles, concepts and conventions to solving accounting problems

subtopics.name: Ethics and Qualities of an Accountant
objectives: Apply ethics in preparing and presenting accounting reports
List the qualities of an accountant: honesty, integrity, transparency, accountability and fairness

subtopics.name: Source Documents and Books of Original Entry
objectives: Relate the various source documents (invoice, receipt, credit note, debit note, cheque) to their uses
Relate source documents to the books of original entry (sales day book, purchases day book, returns books, journal proper, cashbook)
Record transactions in the appropriate books of original entry

subtopics.name: The Accounting Equation and Ledger Entries
objectives: Determine the effect of transactions on the accounting equation (Assets = Capital + Liabilities)
Apply the double entry rule to post transactions into the divisions of the ledger
Classify accounts into personal, real and nominal accounts
Balance off ledger accounts

subtopics.name: The Trial Balance
objectives: Extract a trial balance from ledger balances
State the uses and limitations of the trial balance

subtopics.name: Errors and Suspense Accounts
objectives: Identify errors that do and do not affect the trial balance (errors of omission, commission, principle, original entry, complete reversal, compensating)
Correct errors using the journal
Create and clear a suspense account and determine the effect of errors on profit

subtopics.name: Types of Cashbook and Discounts
objectives: Differentiate between single, two and three column cashbooks and record transactions in them
Differentiate between trade discount and cash discount
Examine the effects of trade and cash discounts in the books of account
Determine cash and bank balances including contra entries

subtopics.name: Petty Cash Book and the Imprest System
objectives: Explain the imprest system and determine the cash float
Identify petty cash expenses and post them using analysis columns
Prepare and balance the petty cash book

subtopics.name: Bank Documents and Transactions
objectives: Identify bank documents (cheques, pay-in-slips, credit and debit cards) and their uses
Assess the impact of automated credit systems, credit transfers, interbank transfers and direct debits on cash balances
Distinguish between types of accounts: current, savings, fixed deposit

subtopics.name: Bank Reconciliation Statements
objectives: List the factors causing discrepancies between cashbook and bank statement balances (unpresented cheques, uncredited lodgements, bank charges, standing orders, dishonoured cheques)
Prepare the adjusted cashbook
Prepare bank reconciliation statements

topics.name: Final Accounts of a Sole Trader

subtopics.name: Trading, Profit and Loss Account
objectives: Determine cost of sales, gross profit and net profit of a sole trader
Prepare the trading account and the profit and loss account
Compute mark-up, margin and rate of stock turnover

subtopics.name: Balance Sheet (Statement of Financial Position)
objectives: Identify fixed assets, current assets, long-term liabilities, current liabilities and proprietor's capital
Prepare the balance sheet of a sole trader
Calculate working capital, capital owned and capital employed

subtopics.name: Adjustments in Final Accounts
objectives: Compute adjustments for accruals and prepayments of expenses and incomes
Differentiate between bad debts and provision for bad and doubtful debts and account for them
Calculate depreciation using straight line and reducing balance methods and record it in the accounts
Relate adjustable items to their disclosure in the statement of financial position

subtopics.name: Methods of Stock Valuation
objectives: Determine the cost of materials issued or cost of goods sold using FIFO, LIFO and simple average methods
Calculate closing stock using FIFO, LIFO and simple average
Compare the advantages and disadvantages of each stock valuation method
Determine the effects of stock valuation methods on profit and cost of goods sold

subtopics.name: Preparation and Uses of Control Accounts
objectives: Determine the importance and uses of control accounts
Differentiate between sales ledger control account and purchases ledger control account
Identify the individual elements of control accounts
Prepare sales ledger and purchases ledger control accounts

subtopics.name: Single Entry and Conversion to Double Entry
objectives: Determine proprietor's capital using the statement of affairs
Determine sales, purchases, cash balances, debtors, creditors and expenses by converting single entry to double entry
Use the accounting equation and gross profit percentage to determine gross profit or cost of sales
Prepare final accounts from incomplete records

subtopics.name: Preparation of Manufacturing Accounts
objectives: Calculate prime cost, production overhead, production cost and total cost
Determine the basis of apportionment of expenses into production, administration, selling and distribution
Prepare manufacturing accounts including work-in-progress adjustments

subtopics.name: Receipts and Payments Account
objectives: Distinguish the features of not-for-profit-making organizations
Prepare the receipts and payments account
Compute cash balances from all sources

subtopics.name: Income and Expenditure Account
objectives: Determine subscription income, subscriptions in arrears and in advance
Compute accumulated fund, surplus and deficit for the period
Prepare the income and expenditure account and statement of financial position

subtopics.name: Preparation of Departmental Accounts
objectives: Identify the reasons for preparing departmental accounts
Determine and apportion expenses associated with individual departments
Compute departmental profits or losses

subtopics.name: Preparation of Branch Accounts
objectives: Determine the reasons for keeping branch accounts
Calculate profits and losses of branches
Determine the sources of differences between branch and head office records and reconcile them
Account for goods sent to branch at cost and at selling price

subtopics.name: Preparation of Joint Venture Accounts
objectives: Identify the objectives and features of a joint venture
Determine the profit or loss of the joint venture (memorandum joint venture account)
Determine the profit or loss share of each venturer

subtopics.name: Formation and Profit Sharing
objectives: Determine the instruments of partnership formation (partnership deed) and its contents
Prepare the profit and loss appropriation account (interest on capital, interest on drawings, salaries)
Distinguish between and prepare partners' capital accounts (fixed and fluctuating) and current accounts
Determine the partners' shares of profits or losses

subtopics.name: Admission, Retirement and Goodwill
objectives: Determine the effects of admission and retirement of a partner
Account for goodwill on admission and retirement
Prepare the revaluation account

subtopics.name: Dissolution of Partnership
objectives: Identify the accounts required for dissolution (realization account) and conversion to a company
Prepare dissolution accounts and settle partners' claims

subtopics.name: Types of Companies and Issue of Shares and Debentures
objectives: Differentiate between types of companies (private, public, limited by shares/guarantee)
Explain types of shares (ordinary, preference) and share capital terminology (authorized, issued, called-up, paid-up)
Record the issue of shares (at par, premium, discount) and debentures

subtopics.name: Final Accounts of Companies
objectives: Compute the elements of company final accounts (appropriation account, reserves, dividends)
Prepare the profit and loss appropriation account and statement of financial position of a company

subtopics.name: Interpretation of Accounts Using Ratios
objectives: Calculate and interpret current ratio, acid test ratio and rate of stock turnover
Calculate profitability ratios (gross profit margin, net profit margin, return on capital employed)
Use accounting ratios for decision making

subtopics.name: Government Revenue, Expenditure and Funds
objectives: Differentiate between public sector and private sector accounting
Identify the sources of government revenue
Differentiate between capital and recurrent expenditure
Calculate the consolidated revenue fund and determine values of assets and liabilities

subtopics.name: Government Officers and Control of Public Funds
objectives: Analyse the duties of the Accountant-General, Auditor-General, Minister of Finance and local government treasurer
Distinguish between the elements of control in government accounting: virement, warrant, votes, authority to incur expenditure, budget and due process certificate

subtopics.name: Manual and Computerized Accounting Systems
objectives: Relate and differentiate between manual and computerized accounting processing systems
Identify the processes involved in data processing
Relate the different components of the computer to accounting tasks
Identify the advantages and disadvantages of manual and computerized accounting systems
